def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    shares_purchased = 200_000
    price_per_share_eur = 90
    euro_notional = shares_purchased * price_per_share_eur

    initial_spot_bid = 1.3935
    initial_six_month_forward_bid_points = -19.0

    three_month_spot_ask = 1.4210
    three_month_forward_ask_points = -21.0

    usd_libor = 0.01266
    remaining_term_years = 3 / 12

    # The original hedge sells euros, so it uses the six-month forward bid.
    original_forward_rate = (
        initial_spot_bid + initial_six_month_forward_bid_points / 10_000
    )

    # Closing the hedge requires buying euros, so it uses the current ask.
    closing_forward_rate = (
        three_month_spot_ask + three_month_forward_ask_points / 10_000
    )

    # Discount the forward loss from maturity to the three-month valuation date.
    value_at_maturity = euro_notional * (
        original_forward_rate - closing_forward_rate
    )
    mark_to_market_value = value_at_maturity / (
        1 + usd_libor * remaining_term_years
    )

    # return answer
    return round(mark_to_market_value, 3)
